mapper.update: MERGE INTO MEMBER_PROFILE T USING DUAL ON (T.MEMBER_NO = #{memberNo}) WHEN MATCHED THEN UPDATE SET INTRO = #{intro}, HEIGHT = #{height}, MBTI = #{mbti}, RESIDENCE = #{region} WHEN NOT MATCHED THEN INSERT (MEMBER_NO, INTRO, HEIGHT, MBTI, RESIDENCE, BIRTH_DATE, GENDER) VALUES (#{memberNo}, #{intro}, #{height}, #{mbti}, #{region}, SYSDATE, 'M')

UPDATE MEMBER SET REL_INTENT_ID = (SELECT CODE_ID FROM MASTER_CODES WHERE CODE_NAME = #{relationship}), AFFECT_ID = (SELECT CODE_ID FROM MASTER_CODES WHERE CODE_NAME = #{affection}), EDU_ID = (SELECT CODE_ID FROM MASTER_CODES WHERE CODE_NAME = #{education}), -- 학력 유지 COMM_ID = (SELECT CODE_ID FROM MASTER_CODES WHERE CODE_NAME = #{contact}), ZODIAC_ID = (SELECT CODE_ID FROM MASTER_CODES WHERE CODE_NAME = #{zodiac}), EXERCISE_ID = (SELECT CODE_ID FROM MASTER_CODES WHERE CODE_NAME = #{exercise}), DRINK_ID = (SELECT CODE_ID FROM MASTER_CODES WHERE CODE_NAME = #{drinking}), SMOKE_ID = (SELECT CODE_ID FROM MASTER_CODES WHERE CODE_NAME = #{smoking}), SNS_ID = (SELECT CODE_ID FROM MASTER_CODES WHERE CODE_NAME = #{social}) WHERE MEMBER_NO = #{memberNo}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO MEMBER_INTERESTS (MEMBER_NO, INTEREST_ID) VALUES ( #{memberNo}, (SELECT CODE_ID FROM MASTER_CODES WHERE CODE_NAME = #{interest}) )
